CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_carrier_performance_stats()
RETURNS TABLE (
  transportadora_id UUID,
  nome_fantasia TEXT,
  total_entregas BIGINT,
  entregas_no_prazo BIGINT,
  otif_percent NUMERIC,
  tempo_medio_coleta_horas NUMERIC
) LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH stats AS (
    SELECT 
      e.transportadora_id,
      t.nome_fantasia,
      COUNT(e.id) as total,
      COUNT(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.data_entrega_efetiva <= e.previsao_entrega) as no_prazo
    FROM entregas e
    JOIN transportadoras t ON e.transportadora_id = t.id
    WHERE e.status = 'entregue'
    GROUP BY e.transportadora_id, t.nome_fantasia
  )
  SELECT 
    s.transportadora_id,
    s.nome_fantasia,
    s.total,
    s.no_prazo,
    CASE WHEN s.total > 0 THEN (s.no_prazo::numeric / s.total::numeric * 100) ELSE 0 END as otif_percent,
    NULL::numeric as tempo_medio_coleta_horas -- Placeholder for now
  FROM stats s;
END;
$$;

-- Bloqueio preventivo de acesso anônimo a funções que ainda possam estar expostas
DO $$ 
DECLARE 
    func_record RECORD;
BEGIN
    FOR func_record IN 
        SELECT routine_schema, routine_name 
        FROM information_schema.routines 
        WHERE routine_schema = 'public' 
        AND routine_type = 'FUNCTION'
        AND routine_name NOT IN ('has_role', 'has_permission', 'get_public_tracking', 'get_active_maintenance_mode')
    LOOP
        EXECUTE format('REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION %I.%I FROM PUBLIC, anon;', func_record.routine_schema, func_record.routine_name);
        EXECUTE format('GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION %I.%I TO authenticated, service_role;', func_record.routine_schema, func_record.routine_name);
    END LOOP;
END $$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_monthly_analytics(start_date timestamp with time zone, end_date timestamp with time zone)
RETURNS TABLE (
    month_label text,
    entregas_count bigint,
    coletas_count bigint,
    custo_total numeric,
    sla_atingido integer,
    ocorrencias_count bigint
) AS $$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH months AS (
        SELECT generate_series(
            date_trunc('month', start_date),
            date_trunc('month', end_date),
            '1 month'::interval
        ) AS month_start
    ),
    stats AS (
        SELECT
            m.month_start,
            to_char(m.month_start, 'Mon YYYY') as m_label,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM public.entregas e WHERE e.created_at >= m.month_start AND e.created_at < m.month_start + '1 month'::interval) as e_count,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM public.coletas c WHERE c.created_at >= m.month_start AND c.created_at < m.month_start + '1 month'::interval) as c_count,
            (SELECT coalesce(sum(valor_frete), 0) FROM public.entregas e WHERE e.created_at >= m.month_start AND e.created_at < m.month_start + '1 month'::interval) as total_cost,
            (SELECT count(*) FROM public.ocorrencias o WHERE o.created_at >= m.month_start AND o.created_at < m.month_start + '1 month'::interval) as o_count,
            (
                WITH month_entregas AS (
                    SELECT previsao_entrega, data_entrega_efetiva
                    FROM public.entregas
                    WHERE created_at >= m.month_start 
                    AND created_at < m.month_start + '1 month'::interval
                    AND status = 'entregue'
                ),
                delivered_on_time AS (
                    SELECT count(*) as count
                    FROM month_entregas
                    WHERE previsao_entrega IS NOT NULL 
                    AND data_entrega_efetiva IS NOT NULL 
                    AND data_entrega_efetiva <= previsao_entrega
                )
                SELECT 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM month_entregas) = 0 THEN 100 
                        ELSE (SELECT count * 100 / (SELECT count(*) FROM month_entregas) FROM delivered_on_time) 
                    END
            ) as sla
        FROM months m
    )
    SELECT m_label, e_count, c_count, total_cost, sla::integer, o_count
    FROM stats
    ORDER BY month_start;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.jsonb_recursive_merge(A jsonb, B jsonb)
RETURNS jsonb AS $$
SELECT
  jsonb_object_agg(
    COALESCE(key_a, key_b),
    CASE
      WHEN val_a IS NULL THEN val_b
      WHEN val_b IS NULL THEN val_a
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(val_a) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(val_b) = 'object' THEN public.jsonb_recursive_merge(val_a, val_b)
      ELSE val_b
    END
  )
FROM jsonb_each(A) AS a(key_a, val_a)
FULL OUTER JOIN jsonb_each(B) AS b(key_b, val_b) ON key_a = key_b;
$$ LANGUAGE sql STABLE;

-- 1. Dashboard Metrics MV
DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW IF EXISTS public.mv_dashboard_metrics CASCADE;
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW public.mv_dashboard_metrics AS
SELECT
  1 AS singleton,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM public.coletas) AS total_coletas,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM public.coletas WHERE status IN ('aguardando_liberacao','solicitada')) AS coletas_pendentes,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM public.coletas WHERE status = 'em_transito') AS coletas_em_transito,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM public.coletas WHERE status = 'finalizada') AS coletas_finalizadas,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM public.coletas WHERE divergencia_percentual > 5) AS coletas_com_divergencia,
  (SELECT COALESCE(sum(qtd_volumes),0) FROM public.coletas) AS total_volume,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM public.entregas) AS total_entregas,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM public.entregas WHERE status IN ('aguardando_producao','pronto_despacho','cotacao_frete','nf_emitida')) AS entregas_pendentes,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM public.entregas WHERE status IN ('despachado','em_transito','saiu_entrega')) AS entregas_em_transito,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM public.entregas WHERE status IN ('entregue','finalizado')) AS entregas_finalizadas,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM public.entregas WHERE status = 'ocorrencia') AS entregas_com_ocorrencia,
  (SELECT COALESCE(sum(valor_frete),0) FROM public.entregas) AS valor_total_frete,
  (SELECT
      CASE WHEN count(*) > 0
        THEN (count(*) FILTER (WHERE data_entrega_efetiva <= previsao_entrega AND status <> 'ocorrencia'))::numeric / count(*)::numeric * 100
        ELSE 100 END
    FROM public.entregas
  ) AS otif_rate,
  now() AS last_refresh;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_mv_dashboard_metrics_singleton ON public.mv_dashboard_metrics(singleton);
GRANT SELECT ON public.mv_dashboard_metrics TO authenticated;
GRANT ALL ON public.mv_dashboard_metrics TO service_role;

-- 2. Carrier Performance MV
DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW IF EXISTS public.mv_carrier_performance CASCADE;
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW public.mv_carrier_performance AS
SELECT
  t.id AS transportadora_id,
  t.nome_fantasia,
  count(e.id) AS total_entregas,
  count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.data_entrega_efetiva <= e.previsao_entrega) AS entregas_no_prazo,
  CASE WHEN count(e.id) > 0
    THEN (count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.data_entrega_efetiva <= e.previsao_entrega))::numeric / count(e.id)::numeric * 100
    ELSE 0 END AS otif_percent,
  COALESCE(sum(e.valor_frete),0) AS valor_total_frete,
  now() AS last_refresh
FROM public.transportadoras t
LEFT JOIN public.entregas e ON e.transportadora_id = t.id AND e.status IN ('entregue','finalizado')
GROUP BY t.id, t.nome_fantasia;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_top_queries_fast(p_limit int DEFAULT 10)
RETURNS TABLE(
  queryid bigint,
  query_text text,
  calls bigint,
  mean_exec_ms double precision,
  total_exec_ms double precision,
  max_exec_ms double precision,
  rows_returned bigint
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = internal, public, extensions, pg_catalog
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access denied: admin role required';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'pg_stat_statements') THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY EXECUTE format($f$
    SELECT s.queryid,
           left(s.query, 500) AS query_text,
           s.calls,
           s.mean_exec_time,
           s.total_exec_time,
           s.max_exec_time,
           s.rows
      FROM extensions.pg_stat_statements s
     WHERE s.query NOT LIKE %L
     ORDER BY s.total_exec_time DESC
     LIMIT %s
  $f$, '%%pg_stat_statements%%', p_limit);
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_top_queries_fast(int) TO authenticated;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_cron_jobs_status()
RETURNS TABLE(
  jobid bigint,
  jobname text,
  schedule text,
  active boolean,
  last_start timestamptz,
  last_status text,
  last_duration_ms numeric
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = cron, public, pg_catalog
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access denied: admin role required';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'pg_cron') THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY EXECUTE $f$
    WITH last_run AS (
      SELECT DISTINCT ON (jobid)
             jobid, start_time, status,
             EXTRACT(MILLISECOND FROM (end_time - start_time))::numeric AS duration_ms
        FROM cron.job_run_details
       ORDER BY jobid, start_time DESC
    )
    SELECT j.jobid, j.jobname, j.schedule, j.active,
           lr.start_time, lr.status, lr.duration_ms
      FROM cron.job j
      LEFT JOIN last_run lr ON lr.jobid = j.jobid
     ORDER BY j.jobname
  $f$;
END;
$$;

-- ============================================================
-- SPRINT 37: Real health metrics collector
-- ============================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION internal.collect_db_health()
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = internal, public, pg_catalog
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_active int;
  v_total int;
  v_max int;
  v_db_size bigint;
  v_cache_ratio numeric;
  v_deadlocks bigint;
  v_wal_size bigint;
BEGIN
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'active'), count(*)
    INTO v_active, v_total
  FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = current_database();

  SELECT setting::int INTO v_max FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'max_connections';

  SELECT pg_database_size(current_database()) INTO v_db_size;

  SELECT round(
    (sum(blks_hit)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(blks_hit) + sum(blks_read), 0)) * 100, 2
  ) INTO v_cache_ratio
  FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname = current_database();

  SELECT sum(deadlocks) INTO v_deadlocks
  FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname = current_database();

  BEGIN
    SELECT sum(size) INTO v_wal_size FROM pg_ls_waldir();
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN v_wal_size := NULL; END;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'active_connections', v_active,
    'total_connections', v_total,
    'max_connections', v_max,
    'db_size_bytes', v_db_size,
    'cache_hit_ratio', v_cache_ratio,
    'deadlocks', v_deadlocks,
    'wal_size_bytes', v_wal_size,
    'collected_at', now()
  );
END; $$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION internal.collect_db_health() FROM PUBLIC;

-- ============================================================
-- SPRINT 38: Anomaly detection (z-score on 7-day window)
-- ============================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_health_anomalies_fast()
RETURNS TABLE(
  metric text,
  current_value numeric,
  mean_value numeric,
  stddev_value numeric,
  z_score numeric,
  severity text,
  detected_at timestamptz
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_catalog
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access denied: admin role required';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH stats AS (
    SELECT
      avg(active_connections)::numeric AS mean_conn,
      stddev_samp(active_connections)::numeric AS std_conn,
      avg(cache_hit_ratio)::numeric AS mean_cache,
      stddev_samp(cache_hit_ratio)::numeric AS std_cache,
      avg(deadlocks)::numeric AS mean_dead,
      stddev_samp(deadlocks)::numeric AS std_dead
    FROM public.db_health_snapshots
    WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days'
      AND created_at < now() - interval '1 hour'
  ),
  latest AS (
    SELECT active_connections, cache_hit_ratio, deadlocks, created_at
    FROM public.db_health_snapshots
    ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
  )
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT 'active_connections'::text, l.active_connections::numeric,
           s.mean_conn, s.std_conn,
           CASE WHEN s.std_conn > 0 THEN round(((l.active_connections - s.mean_conn) / s.std_conn)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END,
           CASE
             WHEN s.std_conn > 0 AND abs((l.active_connections - s.mean_conn) / s.std_conn) >= 3 THEN 'critical'
             WHEN s.std_conn > 0 AND abs((l.active_connections - s.mean_conn) / s.std_conn) >= 2 THEN 'warning'
             ELSE 'ok'
           END,
           l.created_at
    FROM latest l, stats s
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'cache_hit_ratio', l.cache_hit_ratio,
           s.mean_cache, s.std_cache,
           CASE WHEN s.std_cache > 0 THEN round(((l.cache_hit_ratio - s.mean_cache) / s.std_cache)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END,
           CASE
             WHEN s.std_cache > 0 AND ((l.cache_hit_ratio - s.mean_cache) / s.std_cache) <= -3 THEN 'critical'
             WHEN s.std_cache > 0 AND ((l.cache_hit_ratio - s.mean_cache) / s.std_cache) <= -2 THEN 'warning'
             ELSE 'ok'
           END,
           l.created_at
    FROM latest l, stats s
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'deadlocks', l.deadlocks::numeric,
           s.mean_dead, s.std_dead,
           CASE WHEN s.std_dead > 0 THEN round(((l.deadlocks - s.mean_dead) / s.std_dead)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END,
           CASE
             WHEN s.std_dead > 0 AND ((l.deadlocks - s.mean_dead) / s.std_dead) >= 3 THEN 'critical'
             WHEN s.std_dead > 0 AND ((l.deadlocks - s.mean_dead) / s.std_dead) >= 2 THEN 'warning'
             ELSE 'ok'
           END,
           l.created_at
    FROM latest l, stats s
  ) x;
END; $$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_health_anomalies_fast() FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_health_anomalies_fast() TO authenticated;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.compute_db_slo_for(p_day date)
RETURNS public.db_slo_daily
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_row public.db_slo_daily;
  v_samples int;
  v_conn numeric; v_cache numeric; v_dead numeric; v_overall numeric;
  v_conn_threshold int := 40; -- connections
  v_cache_threshold numeric := 95; -- %
BEGIN
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_samples
  FROM public.db_health_snapshots
  WHERE created_at >= p_day AND created_at < p_day + 1;

  IF v_samples = 0 THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;

  SELECT
    round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE active_connections <= v_conn_threshold) / v_samples, 2),
    round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE cache_hit_ratio >= v_cache_threshold) / v_samples, 2),
    round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(deadlocks,0) = 0) / v_samples, 2)
  INTO v_conn, v_cache, v_dead
  FROM public.db_health_snapshots
  WHERE created_at >= p_day AND created_at < p_day + 1;

  v_overall := round((v_conn + v_cache + v_dead) / 3.0, 2);

  INSERT INTO public.db_slo_daily (day, samples, connection_slo_pct, cache_slo_pct, deadlock_free_pct, overall_slo_pct)
  VALUES (p_day, v_samples, v_conn, v_cache, v_dead, v_overall)
  ON CONFLICT (day) DO UPDATE SET
    samples = EXCLUDED.samples,
    connection_slo_pct = EXCLUDED.connection_slo_pct,
    cache_slo_pct = EXCLUDED.cache_slo_pct,
    deadlock_free_pct = EXCLUDED.deadlock_free_pct,
    overall_slo_pct = EXCLUDED.overall_slo_pct,
    computed_at = now()
  RETURNING * INTO v_row;

  RETURN v_row;
END; $$;

-- Sprint 40: Forecast de capacidade via regressão linear sobre db_health_snapshots
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_capacity_forecast_fast(p_hours_ahead integer DEFAULT 168)
RETURNS TABLE(
  metric text,
  current_value numeric,
  slope_per_hour numeric,
  forecast_value numeric,
  hours_ahead integer,
  threshold numeric,
  hours_until_threshold numeric,
  severity text
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_is_admin boolean;
BEGIN
  SELECT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin') INTO v_is_admin;
  IF NOT COALESCE(v_is_admin, false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (created_at - (now() - interval '7 days'))) / 3600.0 AS x_hours,
      active_connections::numeric AS conn,
      db_size_bytes::numeric AS size_b,
      created_at
    FROM public.db_health_snapshots
    WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
      AND active_connections IS NOT NULL
      AND db_size_bytes IS NOT NULL
  ),
  stats AS (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*) AS n,
      regr_slope(conn, x_hours)  AS slope_conn,
      regr_intercept(conn, x_hours) AS icpt_conn,
      regr_slope(size_b, x_hours) AS slope_size,
      regr_intercept(size_b, x_hours) AS icpt_size,
      MAX(x_hours) AS x_now,
      (SELECT conn FROM base ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS curr_conn,
      (SELECT size_b FROM base ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS curr_size
    FROM base
  ),
  forecasts AS (
    SELECT 'active_connections'::text AS metric,
           curr_conn AS current_value,
           COALESCE(slope_conn, 0) AS slope_per_hour,
           COALESCE(icpt_conn + slope_conn * (x_now + p_hours_ahead), curr_conn) AS forecast_value,
           80::numeric AS threshold
    FROM stats WHERE n >= 3
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'db_size_gb'::text,
           curr_size / (1024^3),
           COALESCE(slope_size, 0) / (1024^3),
           COALESCE(icpt_size + slope_size * (x_now + p_hours_ahead), curr_size) / (1024^3),
           8::numeric
    FROM stats WHERE n >= 3
  )
  SELECT
    f.metric,
    ROUND(f.current_value, 2),
    ROUND(f.slope_per_hour, 4),
    ROUND(f.forecast_value, 2),
    p_hours_ahead,
    f.threshold,
    CASE
      WHEN f.slope_per_hour <= 0 THEN NULL
      WHEN f.current_value >= f.threshold THEN 0
      ELSE ROUND((f.threshold - f.current_value) / f.slope_per_hour, 1)
    END AS hours_until_threshold,
    CASE
      WHEN f.current_value >= f.threshold THEN 'critical'
      WHEN f.slope_per_hour > 0 AND (f.threshold - f.current_value) / f.slope_per_hour < 48 THEN 'critical'
      WHEN f.slope_per_hour > 0 AND (f.threshold - f.current_value) / f.slope_per_hour < 168 THEN 'warning'
      ELSE 'ok'
    END AS severity
  FROM forecasts f;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_capacity_forecast_fast(integer) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_capacity_forecast_fast(integer) TO authenticated;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_remediation_suggestions_fast()
RETURNS TABLE(
  id text,
  category text,
  severity text,
  title text,
  detail text,
  recommended_action text,
  evidence jsonb
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, extensions, pg_catalog
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_is_admin boolean;
BEGIN
  SELECT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin') INTO v_is_admin;
  IF NOT COALESCE(v_is_admin, false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  -- 1) Regressões críticas → sugerir análise de plano + índice
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    'regression_' || r.queryid::text,
    'query'::text,
    CASE WHEN r.regression_pct >= 100 THEN 'critical' ELSE 'warning' END,
    format('Query %s está %s%% mais lenta', r.queryid, round(r.regression_pct, 0)),
    format('Média atual %sms vs baseline %sms', round(r.current_mean_ms::numeric, 1), round(r.baseline_mean_ms::numeric, 1)),
    'Rodar EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) e avaliar índice na coluna de filtro/join.'::text,
    jsonb_build_object('queryid', r.queryid, 'query', r.query_text, 'regression_pct', r.regression_pct)
  FROM public.get_query_regressions_fast() r
  WHERE r.regression_pct >= 50
  LIMIT 10;

  -- 2) Top queries de alto total_exec → candidatas a cache/materialized view
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'pg_stat_statements') THEN
    RETURN QUERY
    EXECUTE $f$
      SELECT
        'hotpath_' || s.queryid::text,
        'hotpath',
        CASE WHEN s.total_exec_time > 60000 THEN 'critical'
             WHEN s.total_exec_time > 10000 THEN 'warning'
             ELSE 'ok' END,
        'Hot path: ' || left(s.query, 80),
        format('%s chamadas · %sms total · %sms média',
               s.calls, round(s.total_exec_time::numeric, 0), round(s.mean_exec_time::numeric, 1)),
        'Avaliar cache no cliente (React Query staleTime) ou materialized view refresh periódico.',
        jsonb_build_object('queryid', s.queryid, 'calls', s.calls,
                           'total_ms', round(s.total_exec_time::numeric, 0),
                           'mean_ms', round(s.mean_exec_time::numeric, 1))
      FROM extensions.pg_stat_statements s
     WHERE s.query NOT LIKE '%%pg_stat_statements%%'
       AND s.total_exec_time > 10000
     ORDER BY s.total_exec_time DESC
     LIMIT 5
    $f$;
  END IF;

  -- 3) Deadlocks recentes → revisar ordem de locks
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    'deadlocks_recent'::text,
    'contention'::text,
    'warning'::text,
    'Deadlocks detectados nas últimas 24h'::text,
    format('%s deadlocks acumulados na leitura mais recente', COALESCE(latest.deadlocks, 0))::text,
    'Padronizar ordem de acesso a tabelas em transações e reduzir tempo de lock.'::text,
    jsonb_build_object('deadlocks', latest.deadlocks, 'at', latest.created_at)
  FROM (
    SELECT deadlocks, created_at
    FROM public.db_health_snapshots
    ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
  ) latest
  WHERE COALESCE(latest.deadlocks, 0) > 0;

  -- 4) Cache hit ratio baixo → aumentar shared_buffers / compute
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    'cache_low'::text,
    'capacity'::text,
    CASE WHEN latest.cache_hit_ratio < 90 THEN 'critical' ELSE 'warning' END,
    'Cache hit ratio abaixo do alvo (95%)'::text,
    format('Última leitura: %s%%', round(latest.cache_hit_ratio, 2))::text,
    'Considerar aumentar o tamanho da instância do banco para expandir shared_buffers.'::text,
    jsonb_build_object('cache_hit_ratio', latest.cache_hit_ratio, 'at', latest.created_at)
  FROM (
    SELECT cache_hit_ratio, created_at
    FROM public.db_health_snapshots
    WHERE cache_hit_ratio IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
  ) latest
  WHERE latest.cache_hit_ratio < 95;

  -- 5) Conexões próximas do limite → pooling/PgBouncer
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    'conn_pressure'::text,
    'capacity'::text,
    CASE WHEN latest.active_connections >= 60 THEN 'critical' ELSE 'warning' END,
    'Conexões ativas elevadas'::text,
    format('Última leitura: %s conexões ativas', latest.active_connections)::text,
    'Ativar pooling (PgBouncer transaction mode) no lado do app ou aumentar compute.'::text,
    jsonb_build_object('active_connections', latest.active_connections, 'at', latest.created_at)
  FROM (
    SELECT active_connections, created_at
    FROM public.db_health_snapshots
    WHERE active_connections IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
  ) latest
  WHERE latest.active_connections >= 40;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_remediation_mttr_fast()
RETURNS TABLE (
  category text,
  total_applied bigint,
  total_resolved bigint,
  total_ignored bigint,
  total_pending bigint,
  resolution_rate_pct numeric,
  mttr_hours numeric,
  mttr_p50_hours numeric,
  mttr_p95_hours numeric,
  last_resolved_at timestamptz
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access denied: admin role required';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT
      r.category,
      r.status,
      r.applied_at,
      r.resolved_at,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.resolved_at - r.applied_at)) / 3600.0 AS resolve_hours
    FROM public.remediation_actions r
    WHERE r.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
  )
  SELECT
    b.category,
    count(*)::bigint AS total_applied,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.status = 'resolved')::bigint AS total_resolved,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.status = 'ignored')::bigint AS total_ignored,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.status IN ('pending','in_progress'))::bigint AS total_pending,
    ROUND(
      100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.status = 'resolved')::numeric
        / NULLIF(count(*), 0),
      2
    ) AS resolution_rate_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(b.resolve_hours) FILTER (WHERE b.status = 'resolved')::numeric, 2) AS mttr_hours,
    ROUND(
      percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY b.resolve_hours)
        FILTER (WHERE b.status = 'resolved')::numeric,
      2
    ) AS mttr_p50_hours,
    ROUND(
      percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY b.resolve_hours)
        FILTER (WHERE b.status = 'resolved')::numeric,
      2
    ) AS mttr_p95_hours,
    MAX(b.resolved_at) FILTER (WHERE b.status = 'resolved') AS last_resolved_at
  FROM base b
  GROUP BY b.category
  ORDER BY total_applied DESC;
END;
$$;

  recommended_ddl text,
  rationale text,
  confidence text
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'internal', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_catalog'
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_query text;
  v_table text;
  v_col text;
  v_match text[];
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access denied: admin role required';
  END IF;

  SELECT query INTO v_query FROM extensions.pg_stat_statements WHERE queryid = p_queryid LIMIT 1;
  IF v_query IS NULL THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- Heurística: extrai FROM <table> e coluna do primeiro WHERE
  v_match := regexp_matches(v_query, 'from\s+([a-z_][a-z0-9_\.]*)', 'i');
  v_table := COALESCE(v_match[1], NULL);

  v_match := regexp_matches(v_query, 'where\s+([a-z_][a-z0-9_]*)\s*(=|>|<|>=|<=|in|like)', 'i');
  v_col := COALESCE(v_match[1], NULL);

  IF v_table IS NOT NULL AND v_col IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN QUERY SELECT
      'index_where'::text,
      v_table,
      ARRAY[v_col],
      format('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_%s_%s ON %s (%s);',
             regexp_replace(v_table, '\.', '_', 'g'), v_col, v_table, v_col),
      format('Coluna %s aparece em cláusula WHERE do queryid %s. Índice pode reduzir seq scans.',
             v_col, p_queryid),
      'medium'::text;
  END IF;

  -- JOIN heuristic
  v_match := regexp_matches(v_query, 'join\s+([a-z_][a-z0-9_\.]*)\s+.*?on\s+[a-z_\.]*\.([a-z_][a-z0-9_]*)\s*=', 'i');
  IF v_match IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN QUERY SELECT
      'index_join'::text,
      v_match[1],
      ARRAY[v_match[2]],
      format('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_%s_%s ON %s (%s);',
             regexp_replace(v_match[1], '\.', '_', 'g'), v_match[2], v_match[1], v_match[2]),
      format('Coluna %s usada em JOIN. Índice acelera lookup.', v_match[2]),
      'medium'::text;
  END IF;

  -- Se não encontrou, sugere EXPLAIN
  RETURN QUERY SELECT
    'manual_review'::text,
    NULL::text,
    NULL::text[],
    format('EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) %s;', substring(v_query from 1 for 500)),
    'Rode EXPLAIN ANALYZE para inspecionar plano e identificar bottleneck manualmente.',
    'low'::text;
END; $$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_maintenance_windows(p_days integer DEFAULT 30, p_window_hours integer DEFAULT 2, p_limit integer DEFAULT 3)
RETURNS TABLE(

  day_of_week integer,
  day_name text,
  start_hour integer,
  end_hour integer,

  vs_daily_peak_pct numeric,
  recommendation text
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_catalog
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_daily_peak numeric;
  v_dow_names text[] := ARRAY['Domingo','Segunda','Terça','Quarta','Quinta','Sexta','Sábado'];
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access denied: admin role required';
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(avg_conn), 0) INTO v_daily_peak FROM (
    SELECT AVG(active_connections) AS avg_conn
      FROM public.db_health_snapshots
     WHERE created_at >= now() - (p_days || ' days')::interval
       AND active_connections IS NOT NULL
     GROUP BY EXTRACT(DOW FROM created_at), EXTRACT(HOUR FROM created_at)
  ) t;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH hourly AS (
    SELECT
      EXTRACT(DOW  FROM created_at)::int AS dow,
      EXTRACT(HOUR FROM created_at)::int AS hr,
      AVG(active_connections)::numeric AS avg_load,
      MAX(active_connections)::numeric AS peak_load
    FROM public.db_health_snapshots
    WHERE created_at >= now() - (p_days || ' days')::interval
      AND active_connections IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2
  ),
  windows AS (
    SELECT
      h.dow,
      h.hr AS start_hr,
      ((h.hr + p_window_hours - 1) % 24) AS end_hr,
      AVG(h2.avg_load) AS window_avg,
      MAX(h2.peak_load) AS window_peak
    FROM hourly h
    JOIN hourly h2
      ON h2.dow = h.dow
     AND h2.hr IN (SELECT (h.hr + gs) % 24 FROM generate_series(0, p_window_hours - 1) gs)
    GROUP BY h.dow, h.hr
    HAVING COUNT(*) = p_window_hours
  ),
  ranked AS (
    SELECT
      w.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY window_avg ASC, window_peak ASC) AS rk
    FROM windows w
  )
  SELECT
    rk::int,
    dow,
    v_dow_names[dow + 1],
    start_hr,
    end_hr,
    ROUND(window_avg, 2),
    ROUND(window_peak, 2),
    CASE WHEN v_daily_peak > 0 THEN ROUND((window_avg / v_daily_peak * 100), 1) ELSE 0 END,
    CASE
      WHEN v_daily_peak > 0 AND (window_avg / v_daily_peak) < 0.2 THEN '✅ Excelente — carga mínima'
      WHEN v_daily_peak > 0 AND (window_avg / v_daily_peak) < 0.4 THEN '👍 Boa janela'
      ELSE '⚠️ Aceitável — evite operações longas'
    END
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rk <= p_limit
  ORDER BY rk;
END; $$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_table_coaccess_graph(p_limit integer DEFAULT 30)
RETURNS TABLE(
  table_a text,
  table_b text,
  co_occurrences bigint,
  total_calls bigint,
  total_time_ms numeric,
  avg_mean_ms numeric
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, extensions
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access denied';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH q AS (
    SELECT
      s.query,
      s.calls,
      s.total_exec_time,
      s.mean_exec_time
    FROM extensions.pg_stat_statements s
    JOIN pg_database d ON d.oid = s.dbid
    WHERE d.datname = current_database()
      AND s.query !~* '^\s*(begin|commit|rollback|set|show|explain)'
      AND s.calls >= 5
    ORDER BY s.total_exec_time DESC
    LIMIT 500
  ),
  tables_in_query AS (
    SELECT
      q.query,
      q.calls,
      q.total_exec_time,
      q.mean_exec_time,
      lower(m[1]) AS tbl
    FROM q,
    LATERAL regexp_matches(
      q.query,
      '(?:from|join|update|into)\s+(?:public\.)?"?([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)"?',
      'gi'
    ) AS m
    WHERE lower(m[1]) IN (SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public')
  ),
  distinct_pairs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      t1.query,
      t1.calls,
      t1.total_exec_time,
      t1.mean_exec_time,
      LEAST(t1.tbl, t2.tbl) AS ta,
      GREATEST(t1.tbl, t2.tbl) AS tb
    FROM tables_in_query t1
    JOIN tables_in_query t2 ON t1.query = t2.query AND t1.tbl < t2.tbl
  )
  SELECT
    ta::text,
    tb::text,
    COUNT(*)::bigint AS co_occurrences,
    SUM(calls)::bigint AS total_calls,
    ROUND(SUM(total_exec_time)::numeric, 2) AS total_time_ms,
    ROUND(AVG(mean_exec_time)::numeric, 2) AS avg_mean_ms
  FROM distinct_pairs
  GROUP BY ta, tb
  ORDER BY total_time_ms DESC, co_occurrences DESC
  LIMIT p_limit;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_table_coaccess_graph(integer) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_table_coaccess_graph(integer) TO authenticated;

)

  schema_name text,
  table_name text,
  live_tuples bigint,

  idx_scan bigint,

  seq_ratio numeric,

)

STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_catalog
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access denied: admin role required';

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    s.schemaname::text,
    s.relname::text,
    s.n_live_tup::bigint,
    s.seq_scan::bigint,
    s.seq_tup_read::bigint,
    COALESCE(s.idx_scan, 0)::bigint,
    COALESCE(s.idx_tup_fetch, 0)::bigint,
    CASE
      WHEN (s.seq_scan + COALESCE(s.idx_scan, 0)) > 0
      THEN ROUND((s.seq_scan::numeric / (s.seq_scan + COALESCE(s.idx_scan, 0))) * 100, 2)
      ELSE 0
    END AS seq_ratio,
    CASE
      WHEN s.seq_scan > 0
      THEN ROUND(s.seq_tup_read::numeric / s.seq_scan, 1)
      ELSE 0
    END AS avg_tuples_per_scan,
    pg_total_relation_size(format('%I.%I', s.schemaname, s.relname)::regclass)::bigint,
    CASE
      WHEN s.n_live_tup >= 100000 AND s.seq_scan > COALESCE(s.idx_scan, 0) * 2 THEN 'critical'
      WHEN s.n_live_tup >= 50000 AND s.seq_scan > COALESCE(s.idx_scan, 0) THEN 'warning'
      ELSE 'info'
    END::text AS severity
  FROM pg_stat_user_tables s
  WHERE s.schemaname = 'public'
    AND s.n_live_tup >= p_min_live_tuples
    AND s.seq_scan > 0
  ORDER BY (s.seq_scan::numeric * s.n_live_tup) DESC
  LIMIT p_limit;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_unindexed_foreign_keys()
RETURNS TABLE(
  table_name text,
  constraint_name text,
  fk_columns text[],
  referenced_table text,
  table_size_bytes bigint,
  suggested_ddl text,
  severity text
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_catalog
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access denied: admin role required';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH fks AS (
    SELECT
      c.conrelid::regclass::text AS tbl,
      c.conname AS cname,
      c.conkey AS colnums,
      c.confrelid::regclass::text AS ref_tbl,
      c.conrelid,
      c.confrelid,
      n.nspname AS schema_name
    FROM pg_constraint c
    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.connamespace
    WHERE c.contype = 'f'
      AND n.nspname = 'public'
  ),
  fk_cols AS (
    SELECT
      f.tbl,
      f.cname,
      f.ref_tbl,
      f.conrelid,
      f.colnums,
      ARRAY(
        SELECT a.attname
        FROM unnest(f.colnums) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(attnum, ord)
        JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = f.conrelid AND a.attnum = u.attnum
        ORDER BY u.ord
      ) AS col_names
    FROM fks f
  )
  SELECT
    fc.tbl::text,
    fc.cname::text,
    fc.col_names,
    fc.ref_tbl::text,
    pg_total_relation_size(fc.conrelid)::bigint,
    format(
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_%s_%s ON %s (%s);',
      regexp_replace(fc.tbl, '^public\.', ''),
      array_to_string(fc.col_names, '_'),
      fc.tbl,
      array_to_string(fc.col_names, ', ')
    )::text,
    CASE
      WHEN pg_total_relation_size(fc.conrelid) >= 104857600 THEN 'critical'
      WHEN pg_total_relation_size(fc.conrelid) >= 10485760 THEN 'warning'
      ELSE 'info'
    END::text
  FROM fk_cols fc
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    -- Existe algum índice cujas primeiras N colunas cobrem exatamente as colunas da FK (na ordem)
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_index ix
    WHERE ix.indrelid = fc.conrelid
      AND (ix.indkey::int2[])[0:array_length(fc.colnums, 1)-1] = fc.colnums
  )
  ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(fc.conrelid) DESC;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cancel_long_running_query(
  p_pid integer,
  p_terminate boolean DEFAULT false
)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_catalog
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_result boolean;
  v_query text;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: admin role required';
  END IF;

  IF p_pid IS NULL OR p_pid <= 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid PID';
  END IF;

  SELECT query INTO v_query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE pid = p_pid;

  IF p_terminate THEN
    SELECT pg_terminate_backend(p_pid) INTO v_result;
  ELSE
    SELECT pg_cancel_backend(p_pid) INTO v_result;
  END IF;

  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, resource_type, record_id, metadata)
    VALUES (
      auth.uid(),
      CASE WHEN p_terminate THEN 'terminate_query' ELSE 'cancel_query' END,
      'pg_backend',
      p_pid::text,
      jsonb_build_object('pid', p_pid, 'terminate', p_terminate, 'success', v_result, 'query', left(coalesce(v_query, ''), 500))
    );
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    NULL;
  END;

  RETURN v_result;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_cache_hit_ratios(
  p_min_reads bigint DEFAULT 10000,
  p_max_ratio numeric DEFAULT 0.99,
  p_limit integer DEFAULT 30
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  schema_name text,
  table_name text,
  heap_blks_read bigint,
  heap_blks_hit bigint,
  heap_hit_ratio numeric,
  idx_blks_read bigint,
  idx_blks_hit bigint,
  idx_hit_ratio numeric,
  combined_hit_ratio numeric,
  table_size_bytes bigint,
  severity text,
  recommendation text
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_catalog
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: admin role required';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH stats AS (
    SELECT
      s.schemaname::text AS schema_name,
      s.relname::text AS table_name,
      s.heap_blks_read,
      s.heap_blks_hit,
      COALESCE(s.idx_blks_read, 0) AS idx_blks_read,
      COALESCE(s.idx_blks_hit, 0) AS idx_blks_hit,
      pg_total_relation_size(format('%I.%I', s.schemaname, s.relname)::regclass) AS table_size_bytes
    FROM pg_statio_user_tables s
    WHERE s.schemaname = 'public'
  ),
  ratios AS (
    SELECT
      schema_name,
      table_name,
      heap_blks_read,
      heap_blks_hit,
      CASE WHEN (heap_blks_read + heap_blks_hit) > 0
        THEN ROUND((heap_blks_hit::numeric / NULLIF(heap_blks_read + heap_blks_hit, 0)), 4)
        ELSE 1 END AS heap_hit_ratio,
      idx_blks_read,
      idx_blks_hit,
      CASE WHEN (idx_blks_read + idx_blks_hit) > 0
        THEN ROUND((idx_blks_hit::numeric / NULLIF(idx_blks_read + idx_blks_hit, 0)), 4)
        ELSE 1 END AS idx_hit_ratio,
      CASE WHEN (heap_blks_read + heap_blks_hit + idx_blks_read + idx_blks_hit) > 0
        THEN ROUND(((heap_blks_hit + idx_blks_hit)::numeric /
                    NULLIF(heap_blks_read + heap_blks_hit + idx_blks_read + idx_blks_hit, 0)), 4)
        ELSE 1 END AS combined_hit_ratio,
      table_size_bytes
    FROM stats
  )
  SELECT
    r.schema_name,
    r.table_name,
    r.heap_blks_read,
    r.heap_blks_hit,
    r.heap_hit_ratio,
    r.idx_blks_read,
    r.idx_blks_hit,
    r.idx_hit_ratio,
    r.combined_hit_ratio,
    r.table_size_bytes,
    CASE
      WHEN r.combined_hit_ratio < 0.90 THEN 'critical'
      WHEN r.combined_hit_ratio < 0.95 THEN 'warning'
      WHEN r.combined_hit_ratio < p_max_ratio THEN 'info'
      ELSE 'ok'
    END AS severity,
    CASE
      WHEN r.combined_hit_ratio < 0.90 AND r.table_size_bytes > 100 * 1024 * 1024
        THEN 'Tabela grande com cache baixo — considere aumentar shared_buffers ou particionar.'
      WHEN r.idx_hit_ratio < 0.95 AND r.heap_hit_ratio >= 0.98
        THEN 'Cache de índice baixo — revise índices desnecessários ou aumente shared_buffers.'
      WHEN r.heap_hit_ratio < 0.95
        THEN 'Muitas leituras de heap em disco — crie índices cobrindo consultas frequentes.'
      ELSE 'Monitorar — ratio abaixo do alvo mas não crítico.'
    END AS recommendation
  FROM ratios r
  WHERE (r.heap_blks_read + r.idx_blks_read) >= p_min_reads
    AND r.combined_hit_ratio < p_max_ratio
  ORDER BY r.combined_hit_ratio ASC, r.table_size_bytes DESC
  LIMIT p_limit;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_cache_hit_ratios(bigint, numeric, integer) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_cache_hit_ratios(bigint, numeric, integer) TO authenticated;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_replication_status()
RETURNS TABLE (
  pid integer,
  usename text,
  application_name text,
  client_addr text,
  state text,
  sync_state text,
  backend_start timestamptz,
  write_lag_bytes bigint,

  total_lag_bytes bigint,
  write_lag_seconds numeric,
  flush_lag_seconds numeric,
  replay_lag_seconds numeric,
  severity text
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_catalog
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: admin role required';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    r.pid,
    r.usename::text,
    r.application_name::text,
    host(r.client_addr)::text,
    r.state::text,
    r.sync_state::text,
    r.backend_start,
    COALESCE(pg_wal_lsn_diff(r.sent_lsn, r.write_lsn), 0)::bigint AS write_lag_bytes,
    COALESCE(pg_wal_lsn_diff(r.write_lsn, r.flush_lsn), 0)::bigint AS flush_lag_bytes,
    COALESCE(pg_wal_lsn_diff(r.flush_lsn, r.replay_lsn), 0)::bigint AS replay_lag_bytes,
    COALESCE(pg_wal_lsn_diff(r.sent_lsn, r.replay_lsn), 0)::bigint AS total_lag_bytes,
    COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM r.write_lag)::numeric, 0)  AS write_lag_seconds,
    COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM r.flush_lag)::numeric, 0)  AS flush_lag_seconds,
    COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM r.replay_lag)::numeric, 0) AS replay_lag_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN r.state <> 'streaming' THEN 'critical'
      WHEN COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM r.replay_lag), 0) >= 60 THEN 'critical'
      WHEN COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM r.replay_lag), 0) >= 10 THEN 'warning'
      WHEN COALESCE(pg_wal_lsn_diff(r.sent_lsn, r.replay_lsn), 0) >= 16 * 1024 * 1024 THEN 'warning'
      ELSE 'ok'
    END::text AS severity
  FROM pg_stat_replication r
  ORDER BY r.backend_start ASC;
END;
$$;

  severity text,
  recommendation text
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, extensions, pg_catalog
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_db_files bigint;
  v_db_bytes bigint;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: admin role required';
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(temp_files, 0), COALESCE(temp_bytes, 0)
    INTO v_db_files, v_db_bytes
    FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname = current_database();

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    'database'::text,
    current_database()::text,
    v_db_files,
    v_db_bytes,
    NULL::bigint,
    NULL::numeric,
    NULL::text,
    CASE
      WHEN v_db_bytes >= 10::bigint * 1024 * 1024 * 1024 THEN 'critical'
      WHEN v_db_bytes >= 1::bigint  * 1024 * 1024 * 1024 THEN 'warning'
      WHEN v_db_bytes >= 100 * 1024 * 1024 THEN 'info'
      ELSE 'ok'
    END::text,
    CASE
      WHEN v_db_bytes >= 1::bigint * 1024 * 1024 * 1024
        THEN 'Volume alto de spill — aumente work_mem/maintenance_work_mem ou reduza sorts/hash joins.'
      WHEN v_db_bytes >= 100 * 1024 * 1024
        THEN 'Spill moderado — monitorar e ajustar work_mem se persistir.'
      ELSE 'Uso saudável de arquivos temporários.'
    END::text;

  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'pg_stat_statements') THEN
    RETURN QUERY EXECUTE $f$
      SELECT
        'query'::text,
        s.queryid::text,
        s.temp_blks_read + s.temp_blks_written,
        (s.temp_blks_read + s.temp_blks_written) * 8192,
        s.calls,
        round(s.mean_exec_time::numeric, 2),
        left(s.query, 500),
        CASE
          WHEN (s.temp_blks_read + s.temp_blks_written) * 8192 >= 1::bigint * 1024 * 1024 * 1024 THEN 'critical'
          WHEN (s.temp_blks_read + s.temp_blks_written) * 8192 >= 100 * 1024 * 1024 THEN 'warning'
          ELSE 'info'
        END,
        'Query com spill: revise ORDER BY/GROUP BY, adicione índice cobrindo ordenação, ou aumente work_mem por sessão.'
      FROM extensions.pg_stat_statements s
      WHERE (s.temp_blks_read + s.temp_blks_written) > 0
        AND s.query NOT ILIKE '%%pg_stat_statements%%'
      ORDER BY (s.temp_blks_read + s.temp_blks_written) DESC
      LIMIT $1
    $f$ USING p_limit;
  END IF;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_duplicate_indexes(p_limit integer DEFAULT 30)
RETURNS TABLE (
  schema_name text,
  table_name text,
  keep_index text,
  keep_columns text,
  keep_size_bytes bigint,
  keep_scans bigint,
  drop_index text,
  drop_columns text,
  drop_size_bytes bigint,
  drop_scans bigint,
  relationship text,
  drop_ddl text,
  severity text
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_catalog
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: admin role required';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH idx AS (
    SELECT
      n.nspname::text  AS schema_name,
      c.relname::text  AS table_name,
      ic.relname::text AS index_name,
      i.indisunique    AS is_unique,
      i.indisprimary   AS is_primary,
      pg_relation_size(i.indexrelid)::bigint AS size_bytes,
      COALESCE(s.idx_scan, 0)::bigint        AS scans,
      (
        SELECT string_agg(a.attname, ',' ORDER BY k.ord)
        FROM unnest(i.indkey::int[]) WITH ORDINALITY k(attnum, ord)
        JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attnum = k.attnum
      ) AS cols
    FROM pg_index i
    JOIN pg_class c  ON c.oid  = i.indrelid
    JOIN pg_class ic ON ic.oid = i.indexrelid
    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
    LEFT JOIN pg_stat_user_indexes s ON s.indexrelid = i.indexrelid
    WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
      AND i.indisvalid
      AND i.indpred IS NULL
  ),
  pairs AS (
    -- Duplicados exatos
    SELECT
      a.schema_name, a.table_name,
      CASE WHEN a.is_unique AND NOT b.is_unique THEN a.index_name
           WHEN b.is_unique AND NOT a.is_unique THEN b.index_name
           WHEN a.scans >= b.scans THEN a.index_name
           ELSE b.index_name END AS keep_name,
      CASE WHEN a.is_unique AND NOT b.is_unique THEN b.index_name
           WHEN b.is_unique AND NOT a.is_unique THEN a.index_name
           WHEN a.scans >= b.scans THEN b.index_name
           ELSE a.index_name END AS drop_name,
      a.cols AS a_cols, b.cols AS b_cols,
      a.size_bytes AS a_size, b.size_bytes AS b_size,
      a.scans AS a_scans, b.scans AS b_scans,
      a.is_primary OR b.is_primary AS any_primary,
      'exact_duplicate'::text AS relationship
    FROM idx a
    JOIN idx b
      ON a.schema_name = b.schema_name
     AND a.table_name  = b.table_name
     AND a.index_name  < b.index_name
     AND a.cols = b.cols

    UNION ALL

    -- Redundância por prefixo: b cobre o prefixo de a (mantém a, remove b)
    SELECT
      a.schema_name, a.table_name,
      a.index_name AS keep_name,
      b.index_name AS drop_name,
      a.cols, b.cols,
      a.size_bytes, b.size_bytes,
      a.scans, b.scans,
      a.is_primary OR b.is_primary,
      'prefix_redundant'::text
    FROM idx a
    JOIN idx b
      ON a.schema_name = b.schema_name
     AND a.table_name  = b.table_name
     AND a.index_name <> b.index_name
     AND NOT b.is_unique
     AND NOT b.is_primary
     AND a.cols LIKE b.cols || ',%'
  )
  SELECT
    p.schema_name,
    p.table_name,
    p.keep_name,
    CASE WHEN p.keep_name = (
      SELECT idx.index_name FROM idx WHERE idx.schema_name=p.schema_name AND idx.table_name=p.table_name AND idx.index_name=p.keep_name
    ) THEN
      (SELECT cols FROM idx WHERE idx.schema_name=p.schema_name AND idx.table_name=p.table_name AND idx.index_name=p.keep_name)
    ELSE '' END,
    (SELECT size_bytes FROM idx WHERE idx.schema_name=p.schema_name AND idx.table_name=p.table_name AND idx.index_name=p.keep_name),
    (SELECT scans FROM idx WHERE idx.schema_name=p.schema_name AND idx.table_name=p.table_name AND idx.index_name=p.keep_name),
    p.drop_name,
    (SELECT cols FROM idx WHERE idx.schema_name=p.schema_name AND idx.table_name=p.table_name AND idx.index_name=p.drop_name),
    (SELECT size_bytes FROM idx WHERE idx.schema_name=p.schema_name AND idx.table_name=p.table_name AND idx.index_name=p.drop_name),
    (SELECT scans FROM idx WHERE idx.schema_name=p.schema_name AND idx.table_name=p.table_name AND idx.index_name=p.drop_name),
    p.relationship,
    format('DROP INDEX IF EXISTS %I.%I;', p.schema_name, p.drop_name)::text,
    CASE
      WHEN p.relationship = 'exact_duplicate' AND p.a_size + p.b_size >= 10 * 1024 * 1024 THEN 'critical'
      WHEN p.relationship = 'exact_duplicate' THEN 'warning'
      WHEN p.b_size >= 10 * 1024 * 1024 THEN 'warning'
      ELSE 'info'
    END::text
  FROM pairs p
  ORDER BY p.a_size + p.b_size DESC
  LIMIT p_limit;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_duplicate_indexes(integer) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_duplicate_indexes(integer) TO authenticated;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_autovacuum_health(p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
RETURNS TABLE(
  schema_name text,
  table_name text,
  live_tuples bigint,
  dead_tuples bigint,
  dead_pct numeric,
  last_vacuum timestamptz,
  last_autovacuum timestamptz,
  last_analyze timestamptz,
  last_autoanalyze timestamptz,

  autovacuum_count bigint,
  severity text,
  recommended_action text
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_catalog
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'access denied';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH s AS (
    SELECT
      schemaname::text AS sn,
      relname::text AS rn,
      n_live_tup AS lt,
      n_dead_tup AS dt,
      CASE WHEN (n_live_tup + n_dead_tup) > 0
           THEN round((n_dead_tup::numeric * 100.0) / (n_live_tup + n_dead_tup), 2)
           ELSE 0 END AS dp,
      last_vacuum AS lv,
      last_autovacuum AS lav,
      last_analyze AS la,
      last_autoanalyze AS laa,
      CASE WHEN GREATEST(COALESCE(last_vacuum,'epoch'::timestamptz),
                        COALESCE(last_autovacuum,'epoch'::timestamptz)) > 'epoch'::timestamptz
           THEN round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - GREATEST(COALESCE(last_vacuum,'epoch'::timestamptz),
                                                            COALESCE(last_autovacuum,'epoch'::timestamptz))))/86400.0, 1)
           ELSE NULL END AS dsv,
      vacuum_count AS vc,
      autovacuum_count AS avc
    FROM pg_stat_user_tables
    WHERE schemaname = 'public'
  )
  SELECT
    s.sn, s.rn, s.lt, s.dt, s.dp,
    s.lv, s.lav, s.la, s.laa, s.dsv, s.vc, s.avc,
    CASE
      WHEN s.dp >= 20 OR (s.dsv IS NOT NULL AND s.dsv >= 30) THEN 'critical'
      WHEN s.dp >= 10 OR (s.dsv IS NOT NULL AND s.dsv >= 7)  THEN 'warning'
      ELSE 'ok'
    END::text,
    CASE
      WHEN s.dp >= 20 THEN 'VACUUM (VERBOSE, ANALYZE) public.'||quote_ident(s.rn)||';'
      WHEN s.dp >= 10 THEN 'VACUUM ANALYZE public.'||quote_ident(s.rn)||';'
      WHEN s.dsv IS NOT NULL AND s.dsv >= 7 THEN 'ANALYZE public.'||quote_ident(s.rn)||';'
      ELSE 'sem ação'
    END::text
  FROM s
  WHERE s.lt + s.dt > 0
  ORDER BY
    CASE
      WHEN s.dp >= 20 OR (s.dsv IS NOT NULL AND s.dsv >= 30) THEN 0
      WHEN s.dp >= 10 OR (s.dsv IS NOT NULL AND s.dsv >= 7)  THEN 1
      ELSE 2
    END,
    s.dp DESC,
    s.dt DESC
  LIMIT p_limit;
END;
$$;

    ROUND((age(c.relfrozenxid)::numeric / v_freeze_max_age * 100), 2) AS pct,
    s.last_autovacuum,
    pg_total_relation_size(c.oid)::bigint AS size_bytes,
    CASE
      WHEN age(c.relfrozenxid) >= v_freeze_max_age * 0.9 THEN 'critical'
      WHEN age(c.relfrozenxid) >= v_freeze_max_age * 0.7 THEN 'warning'
      ELSE 'ok'
    END::text,
    CASE
      WHEN age(c.relfrozenxid) >= v_freeze_max_age * 0.9
        THEN format('VACUUM (FREEZE, VERBOSE) %I.%I; -- URGENTE: próximo ao wraparound', n.nspname, c.relname)
      WHEN age(c.relfrozenxid) >= v_freeze_max_age * 0.7
        THEN format('VACUUM FREEZE %I.%I; -- preventivo', n.nspname, c.relname)
      ELSE 'Sem ação necessária'
    END::text
  FROM pg_class c
  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  LEFT JOIN pg_stat_user_tables s ON s.relid = c.oid
  WHERE c.relkind IN ('r','m','t')
    AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema','pg_toast')
  ORDER BY age(c.relfrozenxid) DESC
  LIMIT p_limit;
END;
$function$;

      WHEN COALESCE(a.state,'') = 'idle in transaction'

    AND a.pid <> pg_backend_pid()

RETURNS TABLE(
  schema_name text,
  table_name text,
  total_bytes bigint,
  table_bytes bigint,
  indexes_bytes bigint,
  toast_bytes bigint,
  estimated_rows bigint,
  bytes_per_row numeric,
  severity text,
  recommendation text
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: admin role required';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    n.nspname::text,
    c.relname::text,
    pg_total_relation_size(c.oid)::bigint AS total_bytes,
    pg_relation_size(c.oid)::bigint AS table_bytes,
    COALESCE(pg_indexes_size(c.oid), 0)::bigint AS indexes_bytes,
    COALESCE(pg_total_relation_size(c.reltoastrelid), 0)::bigint AS toast_bytes,
    c.reltuples::bigint AS estimated_rows,
    CASE WHEN c.reltuples > 0
      THEN ROUND((pg_relation_size(c.oid)::numeric / c.reltuples), 1)
      ELSE 0
    END AS bytes_per_row,
    CASE
      WHEN pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) >= 10::bigint * 1024 * 1024 * 1024 THEN 'critical'
      WHEN pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) >= 1::bigint * 1024 * 1024 * 1024 THEN 'warning'
      WHEN pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) >= 100 * 1024 * 1024 THEN 'info'
      ELSE 'ok'
    END::text,
    CASE
      WHEN pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) >= 10::bigint * 1024 * 1024 * 1024
        THEN 'Considere particionamento por data ou arquivamento em cold storage.'
      WHEN pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) >= 1::bigint * 1024 * 1024 * 1024
        AND COALESCE(pg_indexes_size(c.oid),0) > pg_relation_size(c.oid)
        THEN 'Índices maiores que a tabela — revise duplicados/redundantes.'
      WHEN pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) >= 1::bigint * 1024 * 1024 * 1024
        THEN 'Avalie VACUUM FULL, pg_repack ou retenção de dados históricos.'
      WHEN pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) >= 100 * 1024 * 1024
        THEN 'Monitorar crescimento; sem ação imediata.'
      ELSE 'Tamanho saudável.'
    END::text
  FROM pg_class c
  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  WHERE c.relkind = 'r'
    AND n.nspname = 'public'
  ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) DESC
  LIMIT p_limit;
END;
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_rls_audit()
RETURNS TABLE(
  schema_name text,
  table_name text,
  rls_enabled boolean,
  policy_count integer,
  has_select_policy boolean,
  has_insert_policy boolean,
  has_update_policy boolean,
  has_delete_policy boolean,
  severity text,
  recommendation text
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: admin role required';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH t AS (
    SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name, c.relname AS table_name,
           c.relrowsecurity AS rls_enabled, c.oid
    FROM pg_class c
    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
    WHERE c.relkind = 'r' AND n.nspname = 'public'
  ),
  p AS (
    SELECT schemaname, tablename,
           count(*)::int AS pol_count,
           bool_or(cmd = 'SELECT' OR cmd = 'ALL') AS sel,
           bool_or(cmd = 'INSERT' OR cmd = 'ALL') AS ins,
           bool_or(cmd = 'UPDATE' OR cmd = 'ALL') AS upd,
           bool_or(cmd = 'DELETE' OR cmd = 'ALL') AS del
    FROM pg_policies
    WHERE schemaname = 'public'
    GROUP BY schemaname, tablename
  )
  SELECT
    t.schema_name::text,
    t.table_name::text,
    t.rls_enabled,
    COALESCE(p.pol_count, 0),
    COALESCE(p.sel, false),
    COALESCE(p.ins, false),
    COALESCE(p.upd, false),
    COALESCE(p.del, false),
    CASE
      WHEN NOT t.rls_enabled THEN 'critical'
      WHEN t.rls_enabled AND COALESCE(p.pol_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'warning'
      ELSE 'ok'
    END::text,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT t.rls_enabled
        THEN format('ALTER TABLE public.%I ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; -- CRÍTICO', t.table_name)
      WHEN t.rls_enabled AND COALESCE(p.pol_count, 0) = 0
        THEN 'RLS ativo mas sem políticas — tabela inacessível via Data API. Adicione políticas ou desabilite RLS.'
      ELSE 'Configuração adequada.'
    END::text
  FROM t
  LEFT JOIN p ON p.schemaname = t.schema_name AND p.tablename = t.table_name
  ORDER BY
    CASE
      WHEN NOT t.rls_enabled THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(p.pol_count, 0) = 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 2
    END,
    t.table_name;
END;
$function$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_rls_audit() FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_rls_audit() TO authenticated;

RETURNS TRIGGER

BEGIN
  IF NEW.data_entrega_efetiva IS NOT NULL

     WHERE entity_id = NEW.id
       AND entity_type = 'entrega'
       AND confirmed_at IS NULL;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.count_prediction_breach_days(
  _target NUMERIC,
  _carrier TEXT DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS INTEGER
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
  WITH daily AS (
    SELECT
      date_trunc('day', created_at)::date AS d,
      AVG(CASE WHEN was_accurate THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS acc_pct
    FROM public.delay_predictions_history
    WHERE was_accurate IS NOT NULL
      AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
      AND (_carrier IS NULL OR transportadora = _carrier)
    GROUP BY 1
    ORDER BY 1 DESC
  ), streak AS (
    SELECT d, acc_pct,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY d DESC) AS rn,
      (acc_pct < _target) AS is_breach
    FROM daily
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT MIN(rn) - 1 FROM streak WHERE NOT is_breach),
    (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM streak)
  );
$$;

-- Consolidação diária idempotente a partir do histórico bruto de health-checks.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rte_rollup_slo_daily(target_day date DEFAULT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc')::date)
RETURNS integer
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  affected integer := 0;
  v_uptime_target numeric := 99;
  v_latency_budget integer := 3000;
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(t.uptime_target_pct, 99), COALESCE(t.latency_p95_budget_ms, 3000)
    INTO v_uptime_target, v_latency_budget
  FROM public.rte_slo_targets t
  WHERE t.gateway = '__global__'
  LIMIT 1;

  v_uptime_target := COALESCE(v_uptime_target, 99);
  v_latency_budget := COALESCE(v_latency_budget, 3000);

  WITH agg AS (
    SELECT
      (h.checked_at AT TIME ZONE 'utc')::date AS day,
      h.gateway,
      COUNT(*)::int AS checks,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT h.online)::int AS failures,
      ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE h.online)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100, 2) AS uptime_pct,
      ROUND(AVG(GREATEST(h.latency_ms, 0)))::int AS avg_latency_ms,
      COALESCE(
        ROUND(percentile_disc(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY GREATEST(h.latency_ms, 0)))::int,
        0
      ) AS p95_latency_ms
    FROM public.rte_gateway_health h
    WHERE (h.checked_at AT TIME ZONE 'utc')::date = target_day
    GROUP BY 1, 2
  ), scored AS (
    SELECT
      a.*,
      LEAST(
        999.99,
        GREATEST(
          0,
          CASE WHEN (100 - v_uptime_target) <= 0
               THEN CASE WHEN a.uptime_pct >= 100 THEN 0 ELSE 100 END
               ELSE ROUND(((100 - a.uptime_pct) / (100 - v_uptime_target)) * 100, 2)
          END
        )
      ) AS error_budget_used_pct
    FROM agg a
  )
  INSERT INTO public.rte_slo_daily_snapshots AS s (
    day, gateway, checks, failures, uptime_pct, avg_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms,
    error_budget_used_pct, status, uptime_target_pct, latency_p95_budget_ms
  )
  SELECT
    sc.day, sc.gateway, sc.checks, sc.failures, sc.uptime_pct, sc.avg_latency_ms, sc.p95_latency_ms,
    sc.error_budget_used_pct,
    CASE
      WHEN sc.uptime_pct < v_uptime_target OR sc.p95_latency_ms > v_latency_budget THEN 'violado'
      WHEN sc.error_budget_used_pct >= 75 OR sc.p95_latency_ms > (v_latency_budget * 0.8) THEN 'atencao'
      ELSE 'ok'
    END,
    v_uptime_target, v_latency_budget
  FROM scored sc
  ON CONFLICT (day, gateway) DO UPDATE SET
    checks = EXCLUDED.checks,
    failures = EXCLUDED.failures,
    uptime_pct = EXCLUDED.uptime_pct,
    avg_latency_ms = EXCLUDED.avg_latency_ms,
    p95_latency_ms = EXCLUDED.p95_latency_ms,
    error_budget_used_pct = EXCLUDED.error_budget_used_pct,
    status = EXCLUDED.status,
    uptime_target_pct = EXCLUDED.uptime_target_pct,
    latency_p95_budget_ms = EXCLUDED.latency_p95_budget_ms,
    updated_at = now();

  GET DIAGNOSTICS affected = ROW_COUNT;
  RETURN affected;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.rte_rollup_slo_daily(date) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.rte_rollup_slo_daily(date) TO authenticated, service_role;
